verdict.rationale: Skyvern's first-party docs describe official Python and TypeScript SDKs. The SDK connects to a cloud Chromium over CDP with Playwright layered on top, and documented methods include page.extract(prompt, schema) and page.agent.run_task. A REST API with a published OpenAPI spec backs the SDKs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage, and evidence of SDK package/install details and SDK versioning documentation.
